# Third-party asset sources

Use only assets with a license that allows game use. Do not import ripped assets from existing games.

- Adobe Mixamo, "Steve" character and humanoid animations: royalty-free game use under Adobe's Mixamo usage guidance.
  Source: https://www.mixamo.com/
  Usage guidance: https://helpx.adobe.com/creative-cloud/faq/mixamo-faq.html
  Attribution record: `Resources/UserCharacters/Steve/ATTRIBUTION.txt`.
- TastyTony, "Low-Poly FN SCAR H": CC BY 4.0 rifle model.
  Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/low-poly-fn-scar-h-c52bc2a8ddaa47caa34e94d69ff72d96
  Attribution record: `Resources/Weapons/TastyTonyScarH/ATTRIBUTION.txt`.

- Kenney Modular Buildings: CC0 modular city/building assets, good for prototype structures.
- Quaternius Toon Shooter Game Kit: CC0 animated character, weapons, loot props and environment assets.
  Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/toonshootergamekit.html
- Poly Haven: CC0 textures, HDRIs and 3D models.
- Poly by Google, "Parachute": CC BY 3.0 low-poly parachute model distributed by Poly Pizza.
  Source: https://poly.pizza/m/2QKxlN6I5VE
  Attribution: "Parachute" by Poly by Google, Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.
- Remy Tauziac, "Airplane 3268": low-poly passenger aircraft distributed by Poly Pizza under Creative Commons Attribution.
  Source: https://poly.pizza/m/bjlICuVX1Sg

Imported Quaternius selections: animated soldier, AK, SMG, shotgun, sniper, pistol, crate, health pickup,
exploding barrel, fixed barrier, and two tree variants. The source assets are CC0; game names, rules, code,
map layout, and gameplay systems in this project remain original.

The user-provided `clock_tower_free_fire_model.glb` is imported as the main play space. Its embedded metadata declares CC BY 4.0 and the required author/source attribution is stored in `Resources/UserMap/ATTRIBUTION.txt`. Reverify the source license before any commercial release.
